fabricationFlags: Programme mislabeled as 3-year 'bachelor'/'degree': official Bellerbys Global Business, Finance and Management at NOVO Nanjing is a 1-year (two-semester) FOUNDATION/pathway programme, not a bachelor degree.
Intake listed as 'November 2026'; official Bellerbys intakes are usually September or December — November is unverified/likely incorrect.

Entity presented as a standalone university/institution; it is actually a Bellerbys Global Study Centre operated in partnership with New Oriental Vision Overseas (NOVO), a study-abroad agency, not a degree-awarding institution.
city = 'China' is a placeholder, not a city; actual location is Nanjing.
Logo uses 'bellerbys-global-logo' (Study Group brand), confirming this is a marketing/pathway entry rather than the named institution.
Gallery/photoSets use generic 'bobr-*.jpg' placeholder images with no real campus photos.
evidence: WebSearch + WebFetch of bellerbysglobal.com confirm Study Group launched Bellerbys Global in-country Study Centres in China via partner New Oriental Vision Overseas (NOVO), with two campuses in Beijing and Nanjing. The Nanjing NOVO centre offers FOUNDATION programmes (Business, Finance and Management; Computing and Engineering), open only to Mainland China passport holders, operated by Beijing New Oriental Vision Overseas Consulting Co., Ltd. Official BFM programme page: duration 'Two semesters (one year)', level = Foundation Programme (prepares for undergraduate study), intakes 'usually September or December', age 16+. No official tuition, scholarship, or accommodation data published for the Nanjing centre. Catalog claims a 3-year bachelor 'degree' with a November 2026 intake — both contradicted by the source. Catalog correctly identifies it as a Bellerbys Study Centre in the description and marks the programme verified:false / source:sg (aggregator), which is honest about provenance. Tuition, deadlines, requirements, scholarships, and accommodation are all empty in the catalog (absent on both sides).
